Reference
=========

If you use CpGtools in your research, please cite the following publications:

#. Wei T, Nie J, Larson NB, Ye Z, Eckel-Passow JE, Robertson KD, Kocher JPA,
   Wang L. **CpGtools: a Python package for DNA methylation analysis.**
   *Bioinformatics*. 2020;36(5):1598–1599.
   doi:`10.1093/bioinformatics/btz916 <https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btz916>`_.

#. Ma T, Nie J, Huang J, Zhang YB, Biernacka JM, Wang L.
   **Multi-output learning for systematic missing value imputation in DNA
   methylation arrays.**
   *Bioinformatics Advances*. 2026;6(1):vbag052.
   Published February 15, 2026.
   doi:`10.1093/bioadv/vbag052 <https://doi.org/10.1093/bioadv/vbag052>`_.
